title: Pile of Flint
description: Adds a craftable block of flint
body:
This is a simple mod that adds a block of flint, called Pile of Flint. Similar to the Iron Block, the Pile of Flint is made in the crafting table with 9 flint. 

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45f04dacd1171d3e1e71833d65075d22b9cc1abb.png)

You can also take it apart and receive 9 flint. 

![Receive flint](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f39109ae029450dd4a9f3da0f880ea14d8b2a17.png)

There are two textures: Vanilla or Whimscape, so choose the one you like better. 

Vanilla

![Vanilla texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a608978f0e9bd90a9f35412424b34fbd9df8a2a.png)

Whimscape

![Whimscape](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c50f74df72ce2936aa38fe34d5b4a25e310297e.png)
